name: Residence Permit for Study

requirements.blocker_text: Requires confirmed admission to full-time study at an Estonian educational institution, and continuing the full curriculum without interruption.
requirements.fix_path: Secure full-time admission to an Estonian institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires sufficient income to support yourself in Estonia, set at four times the national subsistence level (a figure that changes annually with the State Budget Act).
requirements.fix_path: Document income at or above four times the current subsistence level.

evidence_required.document: Admission letter from an Estonian educational institution
Proof of income at 4x the subsistence level
Health insurance valid for the stay

outcome.duration_length: issued for the full study programme, up to 5 years

sources.title: Police and Border Guard Board of Estonia (politsei.ee) -- Residence permit for study

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Estonia's initial build. work_rights is 'restricted': students may work only if it doesn't interfere with continuing full-time study. The source page does not address a post-graduation job-seeker pathway, so switchable_to is left empty rather than assuming one exists -- worth a second pass, since several other countries in this dataset (Netherlands' orientation_year, Portugal's job_seeker_skilled) have an explicit graduate-to-work bridge and Estonia may too. The four-times-subsistence-level income formula is confirmed at tier-1 but the exact current euro figure was not resolved to a national-variables entry in this pass -- the subsistence level itself is set annually by the State Budget Act.
